title: The animals that had this floor first
text: The San Joaquin kit fox, the blunt-nosed leopard lizard and three kinds of kangaroo rat live in this valley, and every one of them is listed as endangered. The natural land they depend on is generally down to less than five percent of what was once here, in scattered fragments. One federal recovery plan covers 34 species of plants and animals in this valley.
